name: ObjectDrawingToolbar
intent: Single-line canvas drawing toolbar: an Edit/View mode toggle, shape tools (select/pan/line/circle/rectangle/polygon), fill & stroke color pickers, an opacity slider, a 90° angle-snap toggle, and unlink/import actions — composed from Toolbar primitives.
when: Provide the full drawing-tool bar for an object/vector canvas
